title: Aureline M5 public-surface diff card
description: Per-component contract for a public-surface diff card: the reusable component that names the public-surface change class (command, schema, SDK, or token) and carries a machine-generated diff so a public-surface change never lands without diff and migration/evidence context. Binds the frozen governance-state vocabulary plus the change class and the diff availability state so a locally generated diff is never presented as the published surface of record. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-review is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the shape.
